records.subject: You're in -- let's get Pioneer Logistics set up
records.body:
Hi Wei,

Welcome! Wrenfield works best once there's a real project in it, so that's the one thing I'd suggest doing first. Inviting your team comes next -- tasks are a lot more useful once more than one person is on them.

Reply any time.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: New signup alert -- *Pioneer Logistics* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Wei replies warmly but non-committally ("at some point") [email:1eb8da03] after two nudges [email:8a98f2b3, email:acdd88fd]; 6 days in with no project, no invite, no milestone, and 8 days left. Engaged-but-passive accounts often drift; Pro plan and responsiveness give some chance.

draft.subject: Happy to do that walkthrough call
draft.body:
Hi Wei,

Glad things are going well, and thanks for the quick reply. Let's take you up on that walkthrough whenever it's useful.

Would a 20-minute call this week work? I can walk you through creating your first project in Wrenfield -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so it's the fastest way to see whether it fits how Pioneer Logistics works. If a call isn't convenient, just tell me how your team plans its work and I'll point you to the right starting place.

Best,
Nadia
